summary: Every round-4 teacher note that was ledgered fixed is fixed on its sheet. This includes ch10-s12's compute ratio, which had survived four rounds; the sheet now carries one fact. The deep dives still stand as the film's spine. AlexNet runs from 150,528 numbers, through the -4 → 0 / 3.88 tin stencil and the convolution slide, to the five-course cathedral, then stencils cut from noise (now shown as the same grid sharpening, not pictures). After that come the ReLU weir, the 60M-weights-versus-12M-answers balance, crops and mirrors, dropout, the two-GPU split, the shortened stride, and 15.3 vs 26.2 with the seven-net caveat. The transformer runs from the bottleneck, through attention, the all-pairs hall and question/label/message cards, to the worked 'crossed the river bank' (2/0/4/2 → ÷√4 → 0.20/0.07/0.53/0.20, re-checked on this sheet), and the ÷8 freeze-versus-pour. Then come eight heads, clock-face positions, attention → feed-forward × 6 (now without the engineer's caption), the n² cost with a 10-word reference beside the 20-word hall, and the causal curtain. An expert will respect it, and a teenager can follow it, because every step is a picture first. The candle structure (belief, a named dissenter at the rim, how long it burned) holds from Gerard at the logic-machine candle to LeCun apart from the worry candle. Two new clarity gaps remain, both in the final chapter, where the film speeds up. In ch15-s03 the picture shows rabbit → (suppressed) → habit, but the narration only says it chose 'rabbit', so a viewer hears one word and reads another. The intervention, the actual evidence for planning, goes unspoken. The rewritten L1502 is a 15-second sentence with three nested clauses and an ambiguous 'he wrote'. It is the one line in the film a 15-year-old would have to replay. L0114 is better at 194 wpm but still brisk. Nothing is critical; these are polish notes on a film that already teaches.

issues.problem: In ch15-s03 the picture shows the intervention: the rabbit lantern is snuffed (b3 11.54), the ghost word becomes 'habit', and the caption 'rabbit → (suppressed) → habit' is up from 12.87. The narration never says any of it. L1504 says it 'chose "rabbit"', and the line on screen ends in 'habit'. A newcomer hears one word and reads another. They also miss the part that makes this evidence and not an anecdote: researchers switched the plan off and the model planned a different rhyme (research/bible.md, claims.json: 'suppressing it yields habit'). The silent gap after L1504 (about 11.0-12.8, where the snuffer falls) is the natural slot.

Keep L1505 exactly as it is, since its level is now right. Then re-fit ch15-s03 so the snuffer drops on 'Snuff' and HABIT glows on 'habit' (T.word), and re-fit the m19 microscope section by the new delta.
